info.title: cosmokv-sql — interactive shell for CosmoKv databases
info.description: Interactive command-line shell for CosmoKv embedded databases. REPL + one-shot SQL + schema dump; table/csv/tsv/json output formats. Installs as a dotnet global tool: `dotnet tool install -g CosmoSQLClient.CosmoKv.Cli` then `cosmokv-sql path/to/db`.

options.name: --help
options.description:
This help.
REPL DOT-COMMANDS
.help                  Show dot-command help
.open FILENAME         Reopen on a persistent database
.databases             Show the current data source
.tables                List user tables
.schema [TABLE]        CREATE TABLE script (all tables if omitted)
.indexes [TABLE]       List indexes (all if omitted)
.dump                  Schema + INSERTs for the entire database
.format FMT            Switch output format mid-session
.quit / .exit / Ctrl-D Leave the shell
